name: Cluster bean plant
group: Plants > Vegetable plants > The seeds or pods

features.claim: The plant grows upright and can reach up to 2 to 3 metres tall.
features.quote: Cyamopsis tetragonoloba grows upright, reaching a maximum height of up to 2–3 metres (7–10 ft).

features.claim: It has one main stem, which may branch at the base or finely along the stem.
features.quote: It has a main single stem with either basal branching or fine branching along the stem.

features.claim: Its leaves are fine, long and oval-shaped, about 5 to 10 centimetres long.
features.quote: Its fine leaves have an elongated oval shape (5 to 10 centimetres (2 to 4 in)) and of alternate position.

features.claim: The leaves and stems are mostly hairy.
features.quote: Its leaves and stems are mostly hairy, depending on the cultivar.

features.claim: Clusters of flowers grow where the leaf meets the stem and are white to bluish in colour.
features.quote: Clusters of flowers grow in the plant axil and are white to blueish in color.

features.claim: The pods are rather flat and slim and hold 5 to 12 small oval seeds about 5 millimetres long.
features.quote: The developing pods are rather flat and slim containing 5 to 12 small oval seeds of 5 millimetres (1⁄4 in) length (TGW = 25–40 grams (1–1+1⁄2 oz)).

features.claim: Mature seeds are usually white or gray.
features.quote: Usually mature seeds are white or gray, but with excess moisture they can turn black and lose germination capacity.

second_reading.claim: It has a taproot that can reach soil moisture deep down.
second_reading.quote: Guar taproots can access soil moisture in low soil depths.

second_reading.claim: It forms root nodules with nitrogen-fixing bacteria in the upper part of its root system.
second_reading.quote: This legume develops root nodules with nitrogen-fixing soil bacteria rhizobia in the surface part of its rooting system.
